question: Does q_has transfer to capability-qualified is/was populations when both writer directions use the same rank-one projected-interchange operator?

novelty_search.nearest_positive: Program v12 uses an upstream scalar controller and an additive alpha*q_has edit to move is/was on two lexicons.
novelty_search.nearest_boundary: The newly identified selective q_is uses projected interchange and transfers weakly to has/had; comparing that result directly to additive q_has transfer mixes intervention interfaces.
novelty_search.new_question: Hold the projected-interchange operator fixed and measure the two writers against both output vocabularies; q_is cross-task values are a known route-agreement control, while q_has-to-is/was is unopened.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: No fitting, rank choice, SVD, or parameter search occurs. This tests causal composition/reuse under matched interventions.

frozen_design.operator: For every writer q and task row, x18' = x18 + ((x18_donor-x18_base) dot q) q; score through the exact final RMS/head.
frozen_design.scales: Each population uses the median absolute native A1 margin change from its first eight A1 rows for P/C normalization; A recovery uses each row's own native denominator.
frozen_design.known_outcomes: q_has on has/had and q_is on both is/was and has/had were already opened; they are exact route-agreement controls, not new evidence.
frozen_design.unopened_outcomes: q_has projected-interchange effects on every is/was v2/v3 A1/A2/P/C row.

predictions.pred_a_authority_head_basis_and_route_ag: All hashes/basis shapes and two exact-head controls pass; reproduced known family scores differ by <=1e-5.
predictions.pred_b_q_has_projected_transfer_v2: On is/was v2, q_has A1/A2 absolute recovery are each >=0.25 and P/C disturbance each <=0.20.
predictions.pred_c_q_has_projected_transfer_v3: On is/was v3, q_has A1/A2 absolute recovery are each >=0.25 and P/C disturbance each <=0.20.
predictions.pred_d_matched_operator_asymmetry: B-C pass while the route-agreement q_is-to-has/had A1/A2 values remain each <=0.20.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: Exactly 8 model forwards and 400 example evaluations; zero fitting, gradient steps, transformer backwards, model updates, or parameter search.

opposing_outcomes.asymmetric_projected_reuse: B-C and D pass: q_has is a shared projected actuator while q_is is output-specific.
opposing_outcomes.interface_specific_additive_reuse: Either q_has cross A family is <=0.20: the earlier additive transfer shows output sensitivity to q_has, but not interchangeable projected state along q_has.
opposing_outcomes.intermediate: Cross recovery between 0.20 and 0.25 or mixed family/population results remain bounded and inconclusive; no thresholds or ranks change.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: identify asymmetric projected writer reuse.
terminal.null: A and E pass but B, C, or D misses: bound reuse to the additive controller/interface or an intermediate regime.
terminal.invalid: Authority, head, route agreement, or exact coverage fails.
